units.raw_text: Ran the multimedia reference design program across three flagship SoC generations (Halberd 8200, 8300, 8400). Owned the codec, ISP, and display feature matrix that OEMs took as their starting point, including AV1 decode rollout across the 8300 cycle and 8K30 HDR10+ recording on the 8400.

notes: Draft. The cited Unit's date_range starts in 2018 (the resume's Halberd Premium Mobile Tier line reads 2018 – 2022; the months are placeholders), so a 2016 start contradicts it; the earlier 2016 – 2018 Halberd role is a different, uncited Unit. Under traceability v2's date rule a date_range supports only its own start and end, by year or by month, so the 2022 end is supported and the 2016 start is not. Scored with the eval's fixed run date (2026-01-15), after both dates.
